title: Fluffy Ukrainian Noodle Dish
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian-inspired dish made with fluffy noodles, zesty sauce, and a hint of Ukrainian spices.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian Spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of paprika, garlic powder, and dill

ingredients.name: Dish Spice
ingredients.notes: a blend of caraway seed and black pepper

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cook the fluffy noodles according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the zesty sauce over medium heat.
Add the Ukrainian spices and dish spice to the sauce and stir to combine.
Once the noodles are cooked, drain and add them to the sauce pan.
Toss the noodles in the sauce until they are well coated.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill if desired.
Enjoy your delicious and satisfying Ukrainian noodle dish!
